feedback: The investigation went smoothly. The key insight was recognizing that fraud-detection is an isolated Kafka consumer (no callers/callees in the topology) so topology-based error propagation tools couldn't find it - the latency tools (traces_latency_origin, metrics_top_movers, correlate_signals) were essential. The investigate_parallel delegation worked well, giving high-quality findings with change attribution. The change chg_2003 being on "kafka" rather than "fraud-detection" directly required the rank_culprit tool to surface it since it's on a different service name. The tools handled async/event-driven architectures adequately.
